exposure: Perinatal asphyxia (induced via umbilical cord occlusion)
outcome: Brain metabolism (Lactate:NAA ratio, NAA:Choline ratio on MRS)
cohort: Newborn lambs (fetal sheep) in which perinatal asphyxia was experimentally induced before cesarean section delivery.
finding: Combined therapeutic hypothermia and melatonin treatment for neonatal encephalopathy provided significantly greater neuroprotection than either treatment alone in newborn lambs.
